description: The origin of each teaching assumption in assumptions.json and development.json. A key is a JSON pointer; '*' matches one object key, and a pointer covers every value below it. Values in 'metadata' describe a file and are not assumptions.

origins_vocabulary.legacy-notebook: A cell of the legacy notebook in 'legacy_notebook'. Cell numbers are zero-based.
origins_vocabulary.book-method: A method from the cited book. The values are not copied from the book.
origins_vocabulary.author: The Rangekeeper author's choice for the teaching example.
origins_vocabulary.derived: Taken from another value in this data package.

legacy_notebook.note: assumptions.json#/source/commit names 6732e83d277c8de81f3dec2906e06d0e75d3b6fa, the same notebook before a history rewrite. That commit is not published; 21107f0 has the same notebook bytes and is on main.

/capex_growth_per_payment_interval.note: Compounded once per five-year payment interval, as in the legacy projection.

/capital_payments.note: Five-year payment sequence of the legacy capital projection.

/currency.note: Currency of the en_AU locale that the notebook sets.

/forecast_span.note: Ten annual periods from 2001, plus the reversion year.

/legacy_correction.note: Correction of a legacy omission, recorded for notebook 02.

/timing/first_income_growth_exponent.note: Income compounds from the start of the calculation span.

/timing/operating_payments.note: Year-end payment convention chosen to restate the legacy annual flows.

/worked_floor_id.note: Choice of the first worked object: Building A hotel Floor 1.

/base_date.note: Base date of the teaching development plan.

/horizon_end_exclusive.note: Ten-year horizon from the base date.

/stabilised_year.note: First year with all packages open.

/starting_state.note: Starting state for the do-nothing comparison.

/operating_inputs.note: Legacy rates rebased to 2027 without a market or inflation adjustment.

/growth_convention.note: One growth calendar, gated by opening dates.

/cost_escalation.note: No cost escalation, to keep the example simple.

/construction_finance_allowance_AUD.note: Fixed teaching allowance for construction finance charges.

/construction_finance_payment_date.note: Payment date of the finance allowance.

/renewal_interval_years.note: Five-year interval of the legacy capital projection.

/renewal_convention.note: Legacy growth per payment interval, applied from each opening date.

/valuation/sale_date.note: End of the holding period of the teaching plan.

/valuation/sale_basis.note: Legacy reversion method, applied to the forecast year after the sale.

/lending/basis.reference: Geltner, Miller, Clayton and Eichholtz (2007), Commercial Real Estate Analysis and Investments, 2nd edition, section 28.4.1
/lending/basis.note: Simple financial feasibility analysis: total development cost is a proxy for completed value.

/funding.note: Illustrative construction funding: equity, bridge limit, draws and test window.

/phases.note: Illustrative phasing. The object identities come from model.json.

/exclusions.note: Scope limits of the teaching plan.
